title: 第21章 虚空炼神法第22章 涅盘之剑
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
苏墨给赵敢当发去了一条信息。
苏玄渊：敢当，我今天可能不上去了，明天再上去。
赵敢当：好的，苏兄，俺知道了，俺跟她们说一声。
赵敢当：苏兄，她们说庇护所的领主可以拉一个群，这样就可以一起讨论。
苏玄渊：是吗，那我研究一下。
苏墨前世是独狼，在庇护所多是补充一些物资，关于这种类似聊天群的功能，在战场上也遇见过，或者等级提升至lv.15也会自动解锁。
【你创建起源庇护所内部联络群，目前群内人数150。
【你在此联络群内的发言将会被群内所有人员查看。
【你将梅话说（严梅）、枫林晚（苏婷）、赵敢当（赵敢当），拉入联络群。
苏玄渊：这样就好了，大家以后可以在这里联络，就不用一个个单独发了。
梅话说：玄渊领主好样的，对了，我们今天好像摸到了沼泽地区。
枫林晚：对对，地上躺了好多的螺狮，结果一鉴定是福寿螺，附图。
[福寿螺（生物），可食用]
食用效果：饱食度+5，精神值-20，生命值+1，美味值-10
特殊效果：服用后，有概率被寄生；收集时有概率获得‘福寿螺的卵’。
赵敢当：俺没吃，给扔了，这东西还不能放进锅里。
苏玄渊：这福寿螺得早点处理掉，不能让它繁殖下去，等我明天上去再说，还发现了什么吗。
赵敢当：没有了，俺们不知道里面有啥，不过苏婷姐在沼泽里的池塘把水装满了。
苏玄渊：我知道了，那就这样，你们明天换个方向寻找吧，也可以试试我们来的那个方向。
梅话说、赵敢当、枫林晚：好的*3。

轻舒出一口气，团队有团队的便利，孤狼有孤狼的优点，有人帮忙探图，比苏墨一个人开图快多了。
拿出晶珠，耐久已经恢复满了，选择使用，苏墨的意识又一次被卷入了晶珠之中。
再睁开眼时，又是这一片浩瀚的星空，苏墨犹如身边的星辰一般，在这星河之中毫不起眼。
开始挑选需要的传承，在进来之前，苏墨就已经想好要选什么方向的了，首先一些副职业肯定是不用考虑的。
其次，《基础五行诀》一类的功法，不用考虑，苏墨现在还未到进阶之时，自然不需要高阶的功法，至于类似于武道的锻体法，苏墨现在还没有资源去供养快速提升。
苏墨要选择的是一门可以提高精神力的法门，对应的神魂。
前世，苏墨修炼的是武道方面的观想法，观想一株莲，通过观想来提高精神力，再配以魔法的锤炼方式，苏墨的神魂等级才能快速提升。
content_en:
Su Mo sent a message to Zhao Gandang.
Su Xuanyuan: Dare you dare, I may not go up today, I will go up tomorrow.
Zhao Gandang: Okay, Brother Su, I understand. Let me tell them.
Zhao Gandang: Brother Su, they said that the lords of the sanctuary can form a group so that we can discuss it together.
Su Xuanyuan: Really? Let me study it.
Su Mo was a lone wolf in his previous life, and he mostly replenished some supplies in the shelter. Regarding this chat group-like function, he has also encountered it on the battlefield, or it will be automatically unlocked when the level reaches lv.15.
[You created an internal contact group at Origin Sanctuary. There are currently 150 people in the group.
[Your comments in this contact group will be viewed by everyone in the group.
[You add Mei Huahua (Yan Mei), Feng Linwan (Su Ting), and Zhao Gandang (Zhao Gandang) to the contact group.
Su Xuanyuan: That’s great. You can contact us here in the future, so you don’t have to send them individually.
Mei said: Well done Lord Xuanyuan, by the way, we seem to have touched the swamp area today.
Feng Linwan: Yes, there are a lot of snails lying on the ground. They were identified as lucky snails. Picture attached.
[Phoenix snail (biological), edible]
Eating effect: satiety +5, mental value -20, health value +1, delicious value -10
Special effect: After taking it, there is a chance of being parasitized; when collecting it, there is a chance of getting 'Plush snail eggs'.
Zhao Gandang: I didn’t eat it, so I threw it away. This thing can’t be put into the pot.
Su Xuanyuan: This lucky snail must be dealt with as soon as possible, and it cannot be allowed to reproduce. I will wait until I go up tomorrow to find out anything else.
Zhao Gandang: No more. We don’t know what’s in it, but Sister Su Ting filled the pond in the swamp with water.
Su Xuanyuan: I understand. That's it. You can search in another direction tomorrow. You can also try the direction we came from.
Mei Huahua, Zhao Gandang, Feng Linwan: Okay*3.
He let out a sigh of relief. A team has the convenience of a team, and a lone wolf has the advantages of a lone wolf. Someone can help him explore the map, which is much faster than Su Mo alone.
Taking out the crystal bead, the durability had been restored to full, and he chose to use it. Su Mo's consciousness was once again involved in the crystal bead.
When he opened his eyes again, he saw this vast starry sky again. Su Mo was like the stars around him, inconspicuous in this galaxy.
Starting to select the inheritance he needed, Su Mo had already decided which direction to choose before coming in. First of all, there was definitely no need to consider some sub-professions.
Secondly, there is no need to consider exercises such as "Basic Five Elements Technique". Su Mo has not yet advanced, so he naturally does not need high-level exercises. As for body-building methods similar to martial arts, Su Mo does not have the resources to support rapid improvement.
What Su Mo wants to choose is a method that can improve spiritual power and the corresponding soul.
In his previous life, Su Mo practiced martial arts visualization methods. He visualized a lotus and improved his spiritual power through visualization. Coupled with the magical tempering method, Su Mo's soul level could be quickly improved.
